QuestInfo.name: The Grandpa Clock of this Area is Me!
QuestInfo.0: Grandpa Clock looked to be happy from having time but now his face is swollen. Go ask what the problem is.
QuestInfo.1: Grandpa Clock is not happy #r#o2600618##k and #r#o2600619##k has shown up in Ludibrium where he has been in charge of for over hundred years. He is not happy they run around without restraint. He believes himself to be the only person for this area.
QuestInfo.2: You went and took care of  #o2600618# and #o2600619# for Grandpa Clock who is overly protective of his area.

0.0: This is getting ridiculous. Listen, I've been in Ludibrium for over 100 years. I was treated as a useless clock since time stopped, but I never once thought about leaving this place.
0.1: But these #r#o2600618##k and #r#o2600619##k came along and started to act like they own the place. Am I not entitled to be mad about this? I NEED to show them who's in charge around here. And I need YOU to do it.

yes.0: I'm actually a scary grandfather clock. More like a godfather clock! I'll show no mercy about hunting down #r#o2600618##k and #r#o2600619##k. I'm counting on you, #h0#!

no.0: I-I thought we were friends. When did we become so distant?

1.0: Did you teach those intruders a lesson?

yes.0: Nobody better mess with my turf! Mwahaha!

default.0: My pride is at stake! I'M the only clock in charge around here. ME!
